head: 02a657d81edc4d4ec080c488bd65983b167406a1
assessment_scope: Independent repository-only assessment of the complete declared Savia/FLUJO hackathon submission: deterministic R0-R18 core, fictional owned banking actions, two-reviewer durable inquiry and native voice, generic FLUJO packet and isolated architecture, development history, pipeline/publication, routing and provider evaluations, operational analytics and ElevenLabs positioning. Frozen source inspected and meaningful offline checks reproduced; no live provider, other repository, web, deployment, prior rating or peer-rating access.

dimensions.name: Technical judgment
dimensions.reason: Nineteen ordered rules preserve authentication, ownership, selection snapshots, explicit host consent, duplicate/risk completeness, independent receipt verification and uncertain-effect recovery. Models cannot sign or commit bank actions. Current frozen core reproduces 1,078 passes with unchanged protected source and zero external attempts. Generic main/domain separation is source-backed. Full joined cross-platform and long-duration failure qualification remains limited, without a demonstrated blocker for the declared prototype.

dimensions.name: AI engineering
dimensions.reason: Real recorded two-reviewer completions, durable owner-scoped inquiry state, bounded ES/PT generation, canonical native narration, exact current playback acknowledgments and ACK-failure recovery form a working customer path. Fleet consumer preserves dispatch/run identity and checks independent reviewed findings. All 183 application Git objects match the latest native source pin. Reviewer outputs are narrow structured suggestion choices; historical selected-fact failure, limited open-ended quality and absent accepted 100-agent customer completion constrain broader claims.

dimensions.name: Data engineering
dimensions.reason: Full historical 5,899,720-row/six-table receipts, deterministic bronze/silver/gold contracts, quarantine, row reconciliation, lineage, customer/product isolation, corrections and validated immutable publication are substantial. Current fixture replay passes all seven invariants, including repeated logical hashes and retained prior snapshot. Static-source/ETag freshness, full refresh and unqualified power-loss durability remain bounded operating limits; private organizer totals were not recomputed.

dimensions.name: ML/evaluation
dimensions.reason: Strong rejection of template leakage and weak labels; fixed independently AI-authored hashed 120-case ES/PT diagnostic, training-only parameter provenance, keyword comparison, confusion/language slices and paired uncertainty replay. Reproduced 70/94/65 correct cases and 13/3/1 human misses; abstention's 52 unnecessary human routes remain visible. All labels are AI-proposed with only 8/120 automated audit coverage and no human adjudication. Luna's 100 exact-correct outputs tie its deterministic baseline and use ten phrasings, so broad customer quality and incremental ML value remain unestablished.

dimensions.name: Data analytics
dimensions.reason: Ownership and leakage findings change product decisions. Read-only metadata analytics preserves source hashes, omits private text/identity, distinguishes workflow/transcript and current host slots, checks owner/expiry/receipts and avoids duplicate source counts. Operating arithmetic reproduces latency, token/cache burden and routing safety/escalation tradeoffs while preserving historical failures. Cost persistence, exact host action-to-turn linkage, card lifetime history, repeat contacts, human pickup and longitudinal customer impact are unavailable.

first_five_findings_in_discovery_order: AGENTS.md/product boundary require generic FLUJO main and isolate banking source; preservation is distinguished from deployment acceptance.
README claims a recorded two-completed-model-reviewer customer workload with saved inquiry context, later supported by the two-worker receipt.
README identifies deterministic R0-R18 as the complete foundation with explicit consent, independent receipts and restart recovery; source subsequently confirms nineteen ordered rules.
README separates native playback acknowledgments and durable fictional card protection from real-bank outcomes; later receipts retain guidance/status/action distinctions.
README separates the 100-conversation design from 300-request and 18-sandbox infrastructure evidence; later receipts preserve a failed exact customer fleet attempt.

checks.result: Latest native pin: all 183 application Git objects/SHA values match. Historical core 38/39 working hashes match, with banking snapshot reader covered separately. Publication pin 8/9 Git objects match; changed object is workflow graph.

defects_and_gaps.finding: No demonstrated blocker found for the fictional declared prototype in inspected evidence and reproduced checks.

The exact customer fleet attempt failed at its initial model call with a disabled provider workspace before delegation. It cannot establish 100-agent customer completion; separate core/two-reviewer/infrastructure results remain valid in scope.

Latest native bilingual batch failed after ES playback and before PT case creation during an unrecorded authentication response wait. Cause remains uncertain; separate PT continuation passed. This is not a reproduced current source failure or a successful whole batch.

All router labels remain AI-proposed; eight-case automated agreement is not human truth or remaining-label approval. Authored diagnostic and narrow baseline-tied provider workload do not establish deployed customer quality.
No durable model cost, exact host-to-turn/query attribution, joined card lifetime history or longitudinal customer/human outcomes. Denominators and unknown values are disclosed.
ElevenLabs comparison says built with two people, while README/development credit three named contributors. Its scale-readiness phrase must retain the explicit outstanding fleet acceptance boundary.

limitations: Repository-only review; no providers, web, other repositories, deployment or new bank actions.
Historical organizer-data aggregate totals were not recomputed from private raw data; public synthetic pipeline behavior was reproduced.
Runtime/provider receipts were inspected and source-congruence checked; no new live acceptance was executed.
Full film and WAV listening were not performed; committed hero and grounded-answer images were viewed.
Frontend Vitest and full FLUJO build were not rerun; pinned selected receipts retain their scope.
Tests use fictional stores and scripted/mocked observations where documented; no broad production-safety inference.
No matched ElevenLabs voice/customer benchmark or external verification of vendor-reported claims.
Human adjudication, real banking/human pickup, push/email delivery, physical hearing/waveform alignment, multi-day reliability and ROI remain separate extensions or unmeasured outcomes.
Separate replay and historical counts were not pooled into a larger test, customer or capacity denominator.
